title: FileVault status
whyItMatters: Whether FileVault is on determines how much data someone can read from the disk after handover and whether recovery keys matter.
source: Apple platform security documentation and the allow-listed read-only fdesetup status query in Private/SystemQueries.ps1
notes: Uses the fixed system-query name only: no shell, no sudo and no credential prompt. A missing binary or denied query is recorded as a skip.
